collection.description: A potter imagines an artificial helper ordered to destroy a family's treasured bowl, and asks whether it could refuse.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A potter imagines an artificial helper ordered to destroy a family's treasured bowl, and asks whether it could refuse.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An elder calls restraint wise, then wonders who gave the helper its rules.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent imagines a helper protecting a child from a careless command.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The researchers propose that a clever maker could program refusal without creating a conscience.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A novice argues that human habits also arise from teaching; no one agrees on the comparison.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A craftsperson objects to treating a seemingly aware being as property.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A trader replies that a device built for work may still be a possession; the argument remains unresolved.
